request: i play the daily word game and want to log how many tries it took, 7 meaning i failed. show a bar chart of how many times i solved it in 1 to 6 tries and failed, my current streak of days played, best streak and win rate
checklist: 2. bar chart of tries from 1 to 7
program:
app "Word game" grid yellow
table wordle tries num 1..7 = 4 "Tries (7 = failed)"
topbar "Word game", wordle, "Log today"
row gap 2
  statcard streak(wordle), "day streak"
  statcard best(wordle), "best streak"
statcard round(count(wordle where tries < 7) * 100 / max(count(wordle), 1)), "% solved", 100
section "Tries", "number of games"
  bars [1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7], count(wordle where tries = it), it
list wordle top 5, "No games logged. Play today's and log it."

request: stamp album with pages by theme: birds, trains, royalty, space, flowers. each stamp has the country, year, theme and whether it is mint or used. show a card per theme with how many stamps and how many are mint
checklist: 1. add a stamp with country, year, theme and mint flag
2. a card per theme with count
program:
app "Stamp album" tag purple
table stamp country text, year num 1800..2100, theme pick Birds|Trains|Royalty|Space|Flowers = Birds, mint bool
topbar "Stamp album", stamp, "Add stamp"
statcard count(stamp), "stamps in the album", 500
grid 2 gap 1
  each options stamp.theme as t
    stack card gap 0
      t bold
      count(stamp where theme = t) big
      count(stamp where theme = t and mint = yes) "mint" faint
list stamp top 10, "The album is empty. Add the first stamp."

request: shared badminton court in our building. I want a weekly grid with days down the side and hours 6 to 9 pm across, tap a free cell to book it in the name I typed at the top, and booked cells show the name
checklist: 2. grid of days by evening hours
3. tap a free cell to book it
5. remove a booking by tapping it
program:
app "Court Slots" game teal
table booking day pick Mon|Tue|Wed|Thu|Fri|Sat|Sun, hour num 18..21, who text
state me text = ""
"Booking as" head
field me "Your name"
each options booking.day as d
  row gap 1
    d bold width 40
    each 18..21 as h
      if count(booking where day = d and hour = h) > 0
        box grow radius 6 pad 1 fill accent tap remove last(booking where day = d and hour = h)
          last(booking.who where day = d and hour = h) small color white
      else
        box grow radius 6 pad 1 fill soft tap add booking day = d, hour = h, who = me
          h "h" tiny

request: quarter goals for my team. objectives with a name, key results under each with a progress from 0 to 100, and an average progress for each objective as a bar. I want to bump a key result up by 10 with a tap
checklist: 2. add a key result with progress under an objective
4. tap to add 10 to a key result
program:
app "OKRs" target purple
table obj name text
table kr obj ref obj, title text, pct num 0..100 = 0 unit "%"
topbar "Key result", kr, "Add key result"
statcard round(avg(kr.pct)), "% overall progress", 100
each obj as o empty "No objectives yet. Add one below."
  section o.name, "avg" round(avg(o.kr.pct)) "%"
    each o.kr as k
      row gap 2 swipe remove k
        k.title grow
        k.pct "%" bold
        button "+10" tap set k.pct = k.pct + 10
form obj, "Add objective"

request: friday board game nights. the game we played, how many players, who won and how long it took in minutes. who wins the most, which games we play the most, and how many nights this month
checklist: 1. log a night with game, players, winner and minutes

table night game text, players num 2..10 = 4, winner text, mins num 10..600 = 60
topbar "Game nights", night, "Log night"
row gap 2

request: i do not just want to know if i prayed but how: in jamaah, on time, late or missed. log each prayer with how it went, show this month's split, a chart of prayers done per day this week against five, and how many i have missed in total
checklist: 1. log a prayer with how it went
2. split of jamaah, on time, late, missed this month
3. chart of prayers per day this week with line at 5
program:
app "Prayer quality" mosque red
table salah which pick Fajr|Dhuhr|Asr|Maghrib|Isha = Fajr, how pick Jamaah|On_time|Late|Missed = On_time
topbar "Prayer quality", salah, "Log prayer"
row gap 1
  each options salah.how as h
    stack grow card gap 0 align center
      count(salah month where how = h) big color if(h = Missed, bad, ink)

request: i always forget gifts. people with their birthday, and for each person ideas with a price and a tick when i bought it. remind me a week before a birthday and show how much i have spent on gifts bought
checklist: 2. add gift ideas for a person
4. reminder a week before a birthday
program:
app "Gift ideas" gift ocean
table person name text, birthday date?
table gift person ref person, idea text, price money?, bought bool
remind "A birthday is coming up. Check the gift list." at person.birthday - 7d at 9:00
topbar "People", person, "Add person"
statcard sum(gift.price where bought = yes), "spent on gifts already"
each person sort name as p empty "No people yet. Add someone and their birthday."
  stack card gap 1 tap edit p swipe remove p
    row
      p.name bold grow
      p.birthday faint
    each p.gift as g empty "No ideas yet. Add one below."
      row gap 2
        toggle g.bought
        g.idea grow color if(g.bought, muted, ink)
        g.price faint
form gift, "Save idea"

request: a list of things to do around the house on weekends. each has how many hours it takes and a status idea, this weekend or done. i set how many free hours i have, and it shows hours planned against that, with chips to filter
checklist: 1. add a project with hours and status
program:
app "Weekend list" tool plum
table proj name text, hrs num 1..24 = 2, status pick Idea|This_weekend|Done = Idea
setting free num = 8 "Free hours this weekend"
state f pick All|Idea|This_weekend|Done = All
topbar "Weekend list", proj, "Add project"
goal sum(proj.hrs where status = This_weekend), free, "hours planned", "h"
choice f
each proj where f = All or status = f sort status as p empty "No projects here. Add a job you keep postponing."
  row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
    stack grow gap 0
      p.name bold color if(p.status = Done, muted, ink)
      p.hrs "h" faint
    if p.status = Idea
      button "This weekend" tap set p.status = This_weekend
    if p.status = This_weekend
      button "Done" fill accent tap set p.status = Done

request: sourdough diary. each bake i note flour grams, water grams, hours of rise and a score from 1 to 5. i want hydration worked out as a percent for every bake, my average hydration, and a line of my scores over the last two months
checklist: 1. log a bake with flour, water, rise hours and score
program:
app "Sourdough" bread orange
table bake flour num 50..2000 unit "g", water num 50..2000 unit "g", rise num 1..48 = 6 unit "h", score num 1..5 = 3
let hyd = round(sum(bake, it.water * 100 / it.flour) / max(count(bake), 1))
topbar "Sourdough", bake, "Log bake"
row gap 2
  statcard hyd, "% average hydration"
  statcard count(bake), "loaves baked"
section "Scores", "last 60 days"
  trend bake last 60 days sort at, it.score
each bake sort at desc as b empty "No bakes yet. Weigh the flour and water for the first loaf."
  row card gap 2 tap edit b swipe remove b
    stack grow gap 0
      round(b.water * 100 / b.flour) "% hydration" bold
      b.flour "g flour," b.rise "h rise" faint
    b.score "of 5" bold

request: our committee holds zakat money. record what comes in, then what we give each recipient, and show the balance left to distribute. also a list of recipients with how much each got this year

request: we are raising money for a school roof. record each pledge with the donor, the pledged amount and the part received so far, show total pledged against target, total received and how many days remain to the deadline
checklist: 1. add a pledge with donor, pledged and received
5. amount still to collect from pledges
program:
app "Roof Fund" heart pink
table pledge donor text, pledged money, received money = 0
setting target money = 1000000 "Fundraising target"
setting deadline date = 2026-12-31
topbar "Pledges", pledge, "Add pledge"
statcard sum(pledge.pledged), "pledged of" target, target
row gap 2
  statcard sum(pledge.received), "received"
  statcard deadline - today, "days left"
"Still to collect from donors" sum(pledge.pledged) - sum(pledge.received) bold
each pledge sort pledged desc as p empty "No pledges yet. Add the first donor."
  row card gap 2 tap edit p swipe remove p
    p.donor bold grow
    stack gap 0 align end
      p.received "of" p.pledged
      if p.received >= p.pledged
        "complete" faint color good
      else
        "due" p.pledged - p.received faint color warn

request: four of us share a car to the office and take turns driving. log each day who drove, the fuel cost that day, and show how much each person has paid, what each owes as an equal share, and who should pay whom
checklist: 1. add a ride with driver and fuel cost
4. what each person paid so far
program:
app "Car Pool" car yellow
table mate name text
table ride driver ref mate, fuel money
let share = sum(ride.fuel) / max(count(mate), 1)
topbar "Rides", ride, "Add ride"
row gap 2
  statcard sum(ride.fuel), "fuel so far"
  statcard round(share), "equal share each"
each mate sort name as m empty "Add the people in your pool below."
  row card gap 2
    stack grow gap 0
      m.name bold
      "paid" sum(m.ride.fuel) "in" plural(count(m.ride), "ride") faint
    stack gap 0 align end
      round(abs(sum(m.ride.fuel) - share)) bold color if(sum(m.ride.fuel) >= share, good, bad)
      if sum(m.ride.fuel) >= share
        "to receive" faint
      else
        "to pay" faint
form mate, "Add person"

request: i want to see my five prayers for today as five rows i can tap when i have prayed, a count of how many done of 5, a grid of the last six weeks so i can see the gaps, and which prayer i miss most this month
checklist: 5. which prayer is missed most this month
program:
app "Five prayers" mosque slate
table salah which pick Fajr|Dhuhr|Asr|Maghrib|Isha = Fajr
let n = count(salah today)
statcard n, "of 5 prayers today", 5
section "Today", "tap when you have prayed"
  each options salah.which as p
    row gap 2 radius 10 pad 1 fill if(count(salah today where which = p) > 0, accent, soft) tap toggle salah today where which = p
      p bold grow
      if(count(salah today where which = p) > 0, "Prayed", "Not yet")
section "Last 6 weeks", "prayers per day"
  daygrid last 42 days, count(salah on it), 5
section "This month", "prayed per prayer"
  each options salah.which as p
    row gap 1
      p grow
      count(salah month where which = p) "of" monthday(today) bold

request: Running a 6 team futsal league. I add the teams and then each result as goals for and goals against, and want an automatic table sorted by points with 3 for a win and 1 for a draw, plus goal difference and games played
checklist: 2. add a result for a team with goals for and against
5. 3 points for a win and 1 for a draw
program:
app "League Table" board blue
table team name text
table result team ref team, gf num 0..30, ga num 0..30
let pts(t team) = sum(t.result, if(it.gf > it.ga, 3, if(it.gf = it.ga, 1, 0)))
topbar "Add result", result, "Add result"
section "Table", "3 for a win, 1 for a draw"
  each team sort pts(it) desc as t empty "No teams yet. Add the teams below."
    row gap 2
      t.name bold grow
      count(t.result) "P" faint
      sum(t.result.gf) - sum(t.result.ga) "GD" faint
      pts(t) "pts" bold
form team, "Add team"

request: treasurer of the market committee keeps a petty cash tin. I write each cash in and cash out with a reason, always see the balance in the tin, spending this month grouped by reason and an alert when the balance drops under 5000
program:
app "Petty Cash" wallet slate dark
table inflow reason text, amount money
table outflow reason pick Tea|Repairs|Stationery|Transport|Other = Tea, amount money
setting low money = 5000 "Low balance alert"
let bal = sum(inflow.amount) - sum(outflow.amount)
topbar "Cash in", inflow, "Add cash in"
statcard bal, "in the tin"
if bal < low
  "Low balance, ask for a top up" bold color bad
section "Spend this month", monthname(today)
  share options outflow.reason, sum(outflow.amount month where reason = it), it
section "Cash out"
  form outflow, "Add cash out"
list outflow by day, "No cash out yet."

request: i shoot film. every roll has a name or label, the film stock, and where it is: loaded, shot, developed or scanned. a next step button on each roll, a count of rolls in each stage and how many frames i have shot in total
checklist: 1. add a roll with film stock and frame count
3. count of rolls in each stage
program:
app "Film rolls" eye grey dark
table roll label text, stock text, frames num 12..36 = 36, stage pick Loaded|Shot|Developed|Scanned = Loaded
topbar "Film rolls", roll, "Add roll"
grid 4 gap 1
  each options roll.stage as s
    stack card gap 0 align center
      count(roll where stage = s) big
      s tiny
statcard sum(roll.frames where stage != Loaded), "frames shot in total"
each roll sort stage as r empty "No rolls yet. Load the first one."
  row card gap 2 tap edit r swipe remove r
    stack grow gap 0
      r.label bold
      r.stock r.frames "frames" faint
    if r.stage = Loaded
      button "Shot" tap set r.stage = Shot
    if r.stage = Shot
      button "Developed" tap set r.stage = Developed
    if r.stage = Developed
      button "Scanned" tap set r.stage = Scanned
    if r.stage = Scanned
      "Done" color good bold
